entries.title: Beyond Shelter: The Role of Korean Apartment Complexes in Middle-Class Identity and Social Stratification in Seoul
paragraphs: Mixed-methods study of apartment housing as a symbolic and material mechanism of class stratification and stigmatization in Seoul, combining interviews, GIS-based spatial analysis, and digital discourse and search-trend analysis.

entries.title: Development for the Public? Gentrification and Displacement as the End of the World for Some
paragraphs: Examines state-led redevelopment in Seoul’s Ahyeon New Town through rent-gap theory, the revanchist city, and Peter Marcuse’s typology of displacement, focusing on displacement, renter exclusion, and the multidimensional loss of home.

entries.title: Mapping Displacement and Gentrification: A Machine Learning Approach to Brooklyn’s Urban Change
paragraphs: Applied machine-learning classification models to evaluate displacement patterns in Brooklyn using Peter Marcuse’s typology of displacement.

entries.title: Gentrification in Williamsburg: How Rezoning Changed the Neighborhood
paragraphs: Conducted a longitudinal GIS analysis of demographic, housing, and land-use change after the 2005 Williamsburg rezoning; selected for the 2024 GSAPP End-of-Year Show.

entries.title: Public Rental Housing in South Korea: Stigmatization and Failure of Social Mix
paragraphs: Examines the stigmatization of public housing and its residents and the limitations of social-mix policies in South Korea.
